evidence: approved evidence transfer -> exact object version
recovery: audit checkpoint operator -> independent checkpoint target

defaults.network: deny-by-default; private backend, data and health endpoints; provider egress blocked
defaults.transport: TLS with peer verification for ingress, private service traffic, data and recovery
defaults.storage: encrypted databases, private versioned evidence, encrypted logs and backups
defaults.secrets: per-principal references injected at runtime; exclude database owner and checkpoint/backup/restore credentials from app services
defaults.checkpoint: separate account and target from primary database; no grant to web, API, worker, queue or backup runtime
defaults.monitoring: closed event codes and aggregate health flags only; no credentials, payloads, identifiers or raw errors
defaults.recovery: isolated target with egress blocked; restore exact versions, check independent checkpoint and reconcile before resume
